question.question: State Marquise Daylight order, action allowance, March moves, Recruit limit and Overwork cost.

expected.expected_answer: Craft using workshops first; then up to three actions plus one per bird card spent outside actions. March up to two moves; Recruit once per turn places one warrior per recruiter. Overwork spends card matching sawmill clearing to place one wood there.

source_passages.quotation: First craft with workshops. Then take **up to three actions**, plus **one per bird card spent outside an action**, in any order and number except Recruit's limit:
**March:** Up to two moves; either may use the same or different warriors. Do not interrupt the compound action to spend a bird card or take another action.
**Recruit:** One warrior at **each recruiter**; only **once per turn**. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place maximum available, choosing among eligible recruiters.
**Overwork:** Spend a card matching a sawmill's clearing to place one wood there.

answer.ruling: First craft with workshops. Then take up to three actions, plus one action per bird card spent outside an action, in any order and number, except for Recruit’s once-per-turn limit.
A March is up to two moves, using the same or different warriors. Do not interrupt this compound action between its moves to spend a bird card or take another action.
Recruit places one warrior at each recruiter and can be taken only once per turn. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place the maximum available and choose among the eligible recruiters.
Spend a card matching the sawmill’s clearing to place one wood there.
